title: Optimize Discord
name: optimize-discord
modal: Discord will be closed to apply this. Turn off the in-game Overlay and QoS High Packet Priority manually in Discord settings, this script cannot change those.
description: Disables Discord hardware acceleration and clears its bloated cache to stop FPS drops in games
deepDescription:
This changes Discord for better in-game performance:

- Hardware acceleration → Off (frees GPU while gaming)
- Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache → Cleared (often gigabytes of junk)

Do manually in Discord for full effect: disable in-game Overlay and QoS High Packet Priority.
